canada.title: N.L.’s top-billing doctor faces malpractice lawsuits from 2 former patients
canada.summary: The ophthalmologist who was Newfoundland and Labrador's top-billing doctor for the last two years straight is being sued by two former patients, including one who says his right eye was completely blinded during a botched cataract surgery.

canada.title: St. John's, province having 'open and frank' talks on open drug use, public safety
canada.summary: The mayor of St. John's says there's been "open and frank discussions" behind the scenes with the provincial government on how to address public safety and open drug use concerns in the capital city.

canada.title: Coroner's inquest into Alberta woman's death in Kenora, Ont., slated to start on Monday
canada.summary: A coroner’s inquest into the death of a 29-year-old Alberta woman at Lake of the Woods District Hospital (LWDH) in Kenora, Ont., is expected to start later Monday morning. Here is what we know about the upcoming proceedings.

canada.title: Provincial bill could pave the way for more trash incineration to make energy
canada.summary: A sweeping bill from the Ford government could pave the way for Ontario to burn more garbage to create energy and address its growing landfill crunch, but critics warn incineration hurts air quality and discourages waste diversion.

canada.title: Montreal students reeling from police violence at Nov. 13 education austerity protest
canada.summary: Montreal students are denouncing the Service de police de la Ville de Montréal (SPVM) for what they call unjustified acts of violence during a protest against education austerity that took place on Friday.

canada.title: Quebec to test its emergency alert system this Wednesday
canada.summary: Quebec residents can expect to hear a loud alert on Nov. 18 at 1:55 p.m., as the province tests its emergency notification system.

canada.title: Nationwide flight grounding unlikely in Canada, says aviation expert
canada.summary: An aviation management expert says Canada is less likely than the United States to ground flights nationwide as that country did on Friday afternoon, calling the Canadian system a model its southern neighbours should look to.

canada.title: One last afternoon in the park for Bailey
canada.summary: Bailey the dog was diagnosed with cancer this year, and her owners are doing everything they can to make sure she has the best time before she is gone. That included throwing her a little party at a Dartmouth park on Sunday so people could show up and give her all the attention in the world.

canada.title: Montreal sputters late, loses Grey Cup again
canada.summary: The Montreal Alouettes' potent offence sputtered in the fourth quarter and the team went home from the Grey Cup empty-handed a second straight year.
